components.purpose: Application startup, CORS configuration, SQLite database metadata base auto-creation settings, SQLite database patches, API router bindings entrypoints, mount storage dynamically to serve media files statically.
System paths configurations, thresholds, and environmental configurations loaded using Pydantic Settings.
Configures SQL database engine, transaction pooling settings, and session scopes generators.
Declares SQLAlchemy models mapping cases, evidence, cameras, videos, ai_detections, recovered_files, chain_of_custody, and reports tables.
Declares Pydantic V2 models defining schema validation configurations for network requests.
Processes video frame extraction via OpenCV, implements YOLOv8n CPU weights inference, normalizes bounding box coordinates ratios, handles transaction integrations, and runs simulated fallback modes.
Calculates file cryptohashes, scans binary block magic byte signatures, maps camera channels, and carves deleted files. Uses mockup generators for partition maps and carving sector fragments.
Fetches, normalizes, and chronologizes ingestion markers, object detections, carved sector coordinates, and investigator audit logs.
Houses API router modules matching FastAPI endpoint maps.
Validates CRUD requests, simulated ingestion uploads, AI analysis configurations, invalid videopath responses, metadata extractions, and YOLO mock package imports.
Audits real YOLOv8 model loading metrics against demo video on main forensic database.
Client-simulation workflow validating ingestion processes, real YOLO CPU models, timeline queries, chain logs, and reports printing on main database forensic.db.

api_endpoints.description: Registers new cases / lists all investigation cases.
Processes image or standard video file ingestion, calculating hashes, identifying vendors, mapping camera files, and carving deleted files.
Gets ingested files linked with cases.
Retrieves video codec configurations parsed via OpenCV.
POST triggers video frame object detection (REAL YOLOv8 or simulated mock). GET lists bounding box coordinates.
Retrieves chronologized unified timeline of all forensic events inside a case.
Gives search-friendly filters on case events timeline.
Lists immutable auditing history trace logs for a device file.
POST compiles markdown dossier, logs report generation event, writes data to disk. GET loads newest report.

known_limitations: Synchronous AI scan: Large files block API worker loops.
Foreground/fallback imports: Ultralytics module checks on CPU only. GPU/CUDA processing flags are not used.
Simulated low-level parsing: Low-level Dahua/Hikvision physical disc reconstructions are mocked.
